description.text: A wide, still view of an empty railway station platform in flat overcast daylight. The platform runs from the foreground toward the tracks, with a strip of tactile paving following its edge. Above the platform, a rectangular illuminated sign is mounted over the platform, its panel glowing softly against the grey air. The platform surface is bare and the station is unoccupied; no figures, luggage, or movement disturb the scene. The space remains quiet and composed, holding the station in a moment of pause. An off-screen narrator's voice begins a continuous Chinese voiceover line, unseen and detached from the platform.
A low station ambience hums beneath the empty platform.

The shot cuts to a medium wide framing toward the tracks at the platform edge. A train is pulling away, its rear carriage sliding past the tactile strip and receding along the rails. The platform remains empty, and the illuminated sign from the first shot is no longer in view; no lettering is readable here. The train catches the flat daylight as the gap between carriage and platform widens. A low rumble rolls back across the tracks, softening as the last carriage shrinks toward the distance. The off-screen narrator's continuous Chinese voiceover finishes over the receding train, while the station settles into stillness.
The train's rear carriage slides past the platform edge and recedes along the tracks.
The train's rumble fades as it draws away.

json.soundscape: Quiet railway station room tone, with the receding rumble of a departing train after the cut.

constraints.text: The target contains no music, including copied background music.

claims.text: Two shots: an empty railway station first, then a train departing.
A single continuous off-screen voiceover line in Chinese begins in shot one and finishes in shot two.
The only visible text is 出口 EXIT 07, shown in shot one.
There is no other dialogue and no music.

speakers.description: An off-screen narrator, unseen, performing the fixed Chinese voiceover line.
